# Psalm 100 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

## 100:4 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** Enter his-gates with-thanksgiving, his-courts with-praise; give-thanks to-him, bless his-name.
- **LOGOS:** Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise! Give thanks to him; bless his name!
- **PNEUMA:** Walk through his gates with gratitude! Enter his courtyards with praise! Thank him and honor his name!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 100:3 (overlap: 10%)

- **EMET:** Know that YHWH he God; he made-us and-to-him we-belong, his-people and-flock-of his-pasture.

- **PNEUMA:** Understand this: the LORD — he is God! He made us, and we belong to him. We are his people, the sheep he takes care of.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
